lines: Mujhse pehli si mohabbat mere mehboob na maang
couplets.en: My love, spare me the asking for the love I once gave you.

lines: Maine samjha tha ke tu hai to darakhshan hai hayaat
couplets.en: I thought your presence was enough to make life shine.

lines: Tera gham hai to hamein dahr ka jhagda kya hai
couplets.en: With the sorrow of loving you, what quarrel had I with the world?

lines: Teri soorat se hai aalam mein bahaaron ko sabaat
couplets.en: It was your face that made spring seem everlasting.

lines: Teri aankhon ke siwa duniya mein rakha kya hai
couplets.en: What did the world hold for me beyond your eyes?

lines: Tu jo mil jaaye to taqdeer nigoon ho jaaye
couplets.en: If I could be with you, even fate would bow.

lines: Yoon na tha, maine faqat chaaha tha yoon ho jaaye
couplets.en: It was only my wish that things should be so.

lines: Mujhse pehli si mohabbat mere mehboob na maang
couplets.en: My love, spare me the asking for the love I once gave you.

lines: Anginat sadiyon ke taareek baheemana tilism
couplets.en: Countless centuries cast their dark and cruel spell.

lines: Resham o atlas o kamkhwab mein bunwaaye hue
couplets.en: Their cruelty was woven into silk, satin and brocade.

lines: Ja-ba-ja bikte hue koocha o bazaar mein jism
couplets.en: Bodies were sold in every lane and marketplace.

lines: Khaak mein lithde hue, khoon mein nahlaaye hue
couplets.en: They were caked in dust and drenched in blood.

lines: Laut jaati hai udhar ko bhi nazar, kya keeje
couplets.en: My eyes keep returning there, what can I do?

lines: Ab bhi dilkash hai tera husn, magar kya keeje
couplets.en: Your beauty still draws me, but what can I do?

lines: Aur bhi dukh hain zamaane mein mohabbat ke siwa
couplets.en: The world holds sorrows beyond those of love.

lines: Raahatein aur bhi hain wasl ki raahat ke siwa
couplets.en: There are other comforts besides being with you.

lines: Mujhse pehli si mohabbat mere mehboob na maang
couplets.en: My love, spare me the asking for the love I once gave you.
